system.description:
You coat yourself in Wind Release Chakra. For the duration, you gain a 30ft flying speed, but at the end of your turn you begin to float down towards the ground, ending this movement within 1-foot of the ground. You cannot suffer falling damage or be knocked Prone as you are always carried by the wind to a safe landing.

Additionally, you are always floating at least 1 feet off the ground for the duration.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, you no longer need to end your movement within 1 feet of the ground. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, if you take the dash Action you gain an additional +60 fly speed until the end of the current turn.
